items.html: For after the dormita they return face to face, and the Mochin are in ZA, and this aspect of illumination does not emerge then at all, as stated above; and the illumination of Mordechai is annulled entirely and becomes hidden within. And the Holy One, blessed be He, wanted that in every year, in those days of Purim, even if ZON are face to face, that illumination would be revealed in those days and not be annulled.
